source_file: Getting Started with SAS Programming/z. All_Demo_Courses/p104d07.sas
notes: Classification logic (substr(Basin,2,1) -> Ocean, three-way OUTPUT split into indian/atlantic/pacific tables) follows the demo's own intent, rewritten with proper IF-THEN/DO blocks per the activity's instruction ('Modify the IF-THEN statements to use IF-THEN/DO syntax') -- the file's one-liner ('Ocean="Indian" and output indian;') chains an assignment and a statement with AND, which is not valid SAS DATA step syntax. Replaced the LIBNAME PG1 course-data dependency (PG1.STORM_SUMMARY) with a small inline DATALINES mock, and added PROC PRINT steps to show the three-way split.
